title.title: Talagrand's expectation-threshold conjectures
title.subtitle: Claim: fractional and integral expectation thresholds differ by at most a universal factor

plain: Cheap proofs that a random structure is unlikely: the rough kind is never much better than the exact kind

beats.text: Expectation thresholds: cheap certificates that a random structure is unlikely
Claimed: fractional certificates round to integral ones, losing a fixed factor
And unions of $2^{75}$ members of a likely family cover all but a cheap set
